name: MTranscriber v1.0.0 — 100% Private Offline AI Transcriber
changelog: 100% On-Device AI speech recognition powered by whisper.cpp engine
Multilingual support with 99+ searchable languages and instant Romanian translation
Dual interactive views: Real-time Millisecond Segments and Consolidated Text
Consolidated Export System: Plain Text (.txt), SubRip (.srt), WebVTT (.vtt), and JSON (.json)
Built-in Model Manager supporting Tiny, Base, Small, Medium, and custom .bin models
Apple Silicon Metal GPU acceleration and optimized Windows single-file packaging
Automated local FFmpeg integration for universal audio format support
